sentences.text: Hello everyone. Welcome to the Slow English podcast. I am Emily. Today, we will talk about Agra.
Agra is a city in India. It is one of the most famous cities in the world because of the Taj Mahal.
Agra is in the north of India near the Yamuna River. It is a big and busy city full of history,
color, and life. The city has many old buildings and beautiful gardens. Every year,
millions of people visit Agra to see its wonders. Let's start our journey and learn more about Agra,
the city of love. Part two, history of Agra. Agra has a long and rich history. It was an important
city during the Mughal Empire many centuries ago. The Mughal kings built many beautiful buildings
here like the Taj Mahal, the Agra Fort, and Fateh Persecri. Agra was once the capital of the Mughal
Empire. Kings and queens lived here in great palaces. The city was full of art, culture, and trade.
Today, you can still see the beauty of that time in its monuments and streets.
Agra's history makes it one of the most interesting places in India.
Part three, the Taj Mahal. The Taj Mahal is the most famous building in Agra and in all of India.
It is one of the seven wonders of the world. It was built by Emperor Shah Jahan for his wife
Mumtaz Mahal after she died. The Taj Mahal is a symbol of love. The building is made of white marble.
It shines in the sunlight and changes color with the sky. Pink in the morning,
white at noon, and golden at sunset. People come from all over the world to see its beauty.
The Taj Mahal is a dream made of stone. Part four, Agra Fort. Another famous place in Agra
is the Agra Fort. It is a big red stone fort near the river. The fort was built by Emperor
Akbar in the 16th century. It was both a palace and a military base. Inside the fort,
there are many beautiful buildings, gardens and halls. You can see the Jahangir palace
and the Modi Masjid, a mosque made of white marble. From the fort, you can even see the Taj Mahal in the
distance. The Agra Fort shows the power and beauty of the Mughal Empire.
Part five, Fatipur Sikri. Fatipur Sikri is another wonderful place near Agra. It was once
the capital of the Mughal Empire. The city was built by Emperor Akbar and is full of palaces,
gardens and mosques. One famous building there is the Bulundarwaza, a huge gate that means
gate of victory. Another is the Jahma Masjid, a large mosque where people still pray today.
Although people left the city long ago, it still looks strong and beautiful.
Fatipur Sikri is like a silent story from the past. Part six, food in Agra. Food in Agra is
full of flavor and spice. One popular dish is Petha, a sweet made from pumpkin. It is soft,
sweet and delicious. Another famous food is Bedai and Alusabzi, a breakfast dish made with
fried bread and spicy potato curry. You can also find chat, a street food with crispy snacks,
yogurt and sauces. Spicy and tasty. People in Agra love to drink chai or tea with milk and sugar.
You can find tea stalls everywhere. Eating in Agra is a joy for the heart and the stomach.
Part seven, the people of Agra. People in Agra are friendly and kind. They love to talk and help
visitors. Many families in Agra have lived there for generations. They are proud of their city
and its history. You can see people working in shops, driving rickshaws or selling souvenirs near
the Taj Mahal. Family life is very important. People like to spend evenings together,
drinking tea and talking. Agra's people make the city warm and full of love,
just like the Taj Mahal itself. Part eight, art and handicrafts. Agra is famous for its art
and handmade crafts. The most beautiful work is marble and lei. The same art used to make the
Taj Mahal. Artists place small colored stones inside white marble to make flowers and patterns.
It takes a lot of skill and time. You can also find leather goods, carpets and jewelry made by
local craftsmen. Many families in Agra have made crafts for hundreds of years.
When you visit the markets, you can see their art and buy something to remember Agra by.
Part nine, markets and shopping. Shopping in Agra is fun. There are many colorful
markets full of sounds and smells. One famous market is Sadar Bazaar, where you can buy clothes,
sweets and souvenirs. Another is Canary Bazaar, full of jewelry, fabrics and decorations.
You can also buy small models of the Taj Mahal to take home. The streets are busy,
but people are friendly. The markets show the energy and spirit of Agra.
Part ten, festivals in Agra. Agra celebrates many festivals full of music and color.
The most famous one is Taj Mahatsov, a big festival near the Taj Mahal. There are dances,
music, food stalls and art shows. People also celebrate Diwali, the festival of lights,
and holy, the festival of colors. During these times, the streets are full of laughter and joy.
Festivals in Agra bring people together. Locals and visitors all celebrate life and happiness.
Part eleven, travel and tourism. Agra is one of the most visited cities in India. Tourists come
from everywhere to see its famous monuments. The best way to travel around is by rickshaw or small
taxi. It's easy and fun. You can visit the Taj Mahal early in the morning for a quiet and magical view.
There are also many hotels and restaurants for travelers. Agra is part of India's golden triangle,
along with Delhi and Jaipur. Three amazing cities full of history and culture.
Agra is a city of love, beauty and history. It is home to the Taj Mahal, one of the most beautiful
buildings in the world. You can walk through old streets, eat sweet pepha and meet kind people.
Agra is a place that touches the heart. Its history and culture make it unforgettable.
I hope you can visit Agra one day and see its beauty with your own eyes. Goodbye or as they say in Hindi, namaste.
